== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tim Anderson]], [[Josh Kohman]]. Named in the caption. The seated players match the single portraits captioned "Mr. Kohman" (IM000682) and "Mr. Anderson" (IM000683) in the same gallery.

== Description ==

Final Confrontation: [[Tim Anderson]] vs. [[Josh Kohman]]. At the [[2002 Bespin Regionals]], Coach's Corner, Apache Plaza Mall, St. Anthony, Minnesota, 15 June 2002.

== Source and credit ==

Published on the MNSWCCG website's "2002 Bespin Regional Weekend Pictures" page: [http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021102035753/http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html Internet Archive]. The page does not say who took the pictures; [[Nick Kolnik]], who ran the site, directed the event.

* '''Source caption:''' "Final Confrontation: Tim Anderson vs. Josh Kohman"
* '''Original image:''' http://mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_weekend_pictures/IM000681.JPG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030727001708/http://mnswccg.com:80/bespin_regional/2002_weekend_pictures/IM000681.JPG Internet Archive]
* '''Date photographed:''' 15 June 2002
